description_en: Enables or modifies the database proxy instance feature for an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于开启或者修改RDS实例的数据库代理实例功能
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-proxy --db-instance-id 'rm-uf6wjk5****' --config-db-proxy-service Startup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBProxy

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the database proxy. Valid values:

Startup: Enables the proxy service.
Shutdown: Disables the proxy service.
Modify: Modifies the proxy service
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭数据库代理，取值：

Startup：开启代理服务
Shutdown：关闭代理服务
Modify：修改代理服务
parameters.name: config_db_proxy_service

parameters.help_en:
The number of proxy instances to enable. Valid values: 1 to 16. Default value: 1.

More proxy instances can process more requests. You can check the load of proxy instances based on monitoring data and specify an appropriate number of proxy instances
parameters.help_zh:
开通代理实例数量，取值：1~16。默认值：1。

更多的代理实例能处理更多的请求，您可以根据监控数据了解代理实例的负载，然后设置合理的代理实例数量
parameters.name: db_proxy_instance_num

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the instance. Only VPC is supported. Valid value: VPC.

This parameter is required when you enable the database proxy
parameters.help_zh:
实例的网络类型。当前仅支持VPC网络，取值：VPC。

开启数据库代理时，该参数必选
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC to which the instance belongs. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the VPC ID.

This parameter is required when you enable the database proxy
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属VPC ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口查询。

开启数据库代理时，该参数必选
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch to which the instance belongs. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the vSwitch ID.

This parameter is required when you enable the database proxy
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属虚拟交换机ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口查询。

开启数据库代理时，该参数必选
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated and does not need to be configured
parameters.name: db_proxy_engine_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database proxy instance. Valid values:
common: General-purpose database proxy.
exclusive: Dedicated proxy (default)
parameters.help_zh:
数据库代理实例类型，取值：
common：通用型代理
exclusive：独享型代理（默认值）
parameters.name: db_proxy_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable connection keep-alive. Valid values:
Enabled: Enables connection keep-alive.
Disabled: Disables connection keep-alive.

Only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL supports this parameter.
When you modify the connection keep-alive status, set ConfigDBProxyService to Modify
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启连接保持。取值：
Enabled：开启连接保持
Disabled：关闭连接保持

仅RDS MySQL支持此参数。
修改连接保持状态时，ConfigDBProxyService取值为Modify
parameters.name: persistent_connection_status

fields.help_en:
The number of CPU cores for the node. Valid values: 1 to 16.
This parameter is required when you specify DBProxyNodes
fields.help_zh:
节点CPU核数，取值1~16。
选择DBProxyNodes时，该参数必选
fields.name: cpu_cores

fields.help_en:
The number of proxy nodes in the zone. Valid values: 1 to 2.
This parameter is required when you specify DBProxyNodes
fields.help_zh:
可用区中代理节点数量，取值1~2。
选择DBProxyNodes时，该参数必选
fields.name: node_counts

fields.help_en:
The zone ID of the node.
This parameter is required when you specify DBProxyNodes
fields.help_zh:
节点所在的可用区 ID。
选择DBProxyNodes时，该参数必选
fields.name: zone_id
